mapper.select: SELECT min_interval_minutes, max_stamps_per_day, require_staff_approval, pending_timeout_minutes FROM stamp_policies WHERE branch_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE stamp_policies SET min_interval_minutes = #{rules.minIntervalMinutes}, max_stamps_per_day = #{rules.maxStampsPerDay}, require_staff_approval = #{rules.requireStaffApproval}, pending_timeout_minutes = #{rules.pendingTimeoutMinutes}, updated_by = #{staffId}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE branch_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT rule_version AS version, stamps_required, reward_name AS name, reward_description AS description, validity_days FROM reward_rules WHERE active
SELECT id, rule_version, stamps_required FROM reward_rules WHERE active FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reward_rules SET active = false WHERE active
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reward_rules (id, rule_version, stamps_required, reward_name, reward_description, validity_days, active, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{version}, #{stampsRequired}, CAST(#{name} AS jsonb), CAST(#{description} AS jsonb), #{validityDays}, true, #{staffId}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE loyalty_accounts SET reward_rule_id = #{ruleId} WHERE current_stamps > 0 AND reward_rule_id IS NULL
UPDATE loyalty_accounts SET reward_rule_id = NULL WHERE reward_rule_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM loyalty_accounts WHERE reward_rule_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE la.current_stamps > 0) AS in_progress, count(*) FILTER (WHERE la.current_stamps >= #{stampsRequired}) AS reaching, COALESCE(sum(la.current_stamps / #{stampsRequired}), 0) AS gift_cards FROM loyalty_accounts la JOIN customers c ON c.id = la.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT la.customer_id, la.current_stamps FROM loyalty_accounts la JOIN customers c ON c.id = la.customer_id WHERE la.current_stamps >= #{required} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY la.customer_id FOR UPDATE OF la
